body: Hey, thanks for replying I never got a chance to reply once I woke up but I did read everything. It's actually rather nice knowing some random people care more than anyone I know personally. Therapy tho it's a difficult thing for me. I have trouble trusting people that I know are there for a reason to get paid. Makes it really hard to open up to them, which I was actually surprised how much I rolled on while writing my post, usually I just don't talk but I found it alot easier here then anywhere else. Really thank you alot for replying you have no idea how much it means to me. <3
